<project-name>.description: Project custom code (app/code, app/design, ...) plus non-core vendor/* packages. Built by running `pb-codegraph index` against the project root inside the web container with templates/per-project-vendor-split.gitignore applied at the project root (excludes vendor/mage-os and vendor/hyva-themes; every other vendor/* package stays indexed). Replace <project-name> with the ddev sitename.

mageos.description: Shared, read-only core index of vendor/mage-os. Built centrally by scripts/build-core-indexes.sh --only mageos and mounted read-only into every project's web container — see docs/cutover.md "Read-only core-index mount".

hyva.description: Shared, read-only core index of vendor/hyva-themes. Built centrally by scripts/build-core-indexes.sh --only hyva and mounted read-only into every project's web container.

deps.description: Shared, read-only core index of curated runtime PHP libs (composer/semver, composer/ca-bundle, laminas/*, ...). Built centrally by scripts/build-core-indexes.sh --only deps and mounted read-only into every project's web container.
